scripts.build: pnpm install && pnpm build-first && turbo run build
scripts.dev:shell: pnpm build-remotes && concurrently -k -n remotes-preview,shell -c green,blue "pnpm -r --filter @polaris/remote-* run preview" "pnpm --filter @polaris/shell run dev"
scripts.dev:admin: pnpm --filter @polaris/remote-admin run build && concurrently -k -n admin-watch,admin-preview,shell -c yellow,green,blue "pnpm --filter @polaris/remote-admin run build:watch" "pnpm --filter @polaris/remote-admin run preview" "pnpm --filter @polaris/shell run dev"
